exposure: lack of a multidisciplinary Pregnancy Heart team
cohort: 162 women with 197 pregnancies complicated by heart disease managed at a maternal-fetal medicine referral centre between June 2011 and December 2020
finding: The lack of a multidisciplinary Pregnancy Heart team may have negatively impacted pregnancy outcomes in women with heart disease, even in a specialized referral center.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were similar between class X (conditions not included in the mWHO classification) and classes II, II-III, and III/IV, mostly for obstetric indications, while in classes II-III and III/IV, cesarean sections were more common for cardiology reasons.
